question: Choose the antonym of 'superficial":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Deep**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"superficial"** means something that exists or appears on the surface, lacking depth, substance, or thoroughness. It often refers to something shallow or concerned only with outward appearances. (सतही)

 
 
• **Example:** His knowledge of the topic was superficial; he only scratched the surface without delving deeper.
 
 
 
• **"Deep"** refers to something that is profound, thorough, or situated far below the surface. It is the opposite of superficial and implies meaningful insight or understanding. (गहरा)
 
 
• **Example:** Her deep understanding of the subject impressed everyone during the seminar.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'superficial'** is **'deep'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Deep**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Shallow **(उथला): Something that is not deep or is superficial in nature.

 
 
• **Example:** The lake is shallow near the shore, but it gets deeper as you move further in.
 
 
 
• **Surface **(सतह): The outermost or uppermost layer of something, often used to describe appearances.
 
 
• **Example:** The surface of the table was polished to a mirror-like finish.
 
 
 
• **External **(बाहरी): Something that exists on the outside or is visible outwardly.
 
 
• **Example:** The external design of the building was modern and eye-catching.
